name: moat: DNS lookup of a threat-intel domain
description: A device resolved a domain that a threat intel feed (abuse.ch ThreatFox, OTX, ...) lists as malicious. Only domain-type indicators are used: URL indicators often point at one bad file on a big platform (github.com, cdn.discordapp.com, dropbox.com), and matching their host would flag everyone who uses it; Elastic's prebuilt URL indicator rule covers full URLs. Check which device asked (source.ip) and what the indicator says (threat.enrichments).
threat_query: @timestamp >= "now-30d/d" and threat.indicator.type:"domain-name" and threat.indicator.url.domain:* and not labels.is_ioc_transform_source:"true"
